papers.title: The concentration game: Bayesian updating, regret, and information
papers.titleZh: 浓度游戏：贝叶斯更新、遗憾与信息
papers.abstract: We give a two-player zero-sum repeated game between a learner and nature whose value identity generates Bayesian updating and an exact accounting of exponential-weights regret at once, and supplies the comparator-class variational form that a wide class of concentration phenomena share. The terminal payoff is the most a comparator can gain at fixed relative entropy from the prior, and the one-step constraint is an information budget on nature's move under the learner's mixed action. With the learner's move otherwise unrestricted, Gibbs/Bayes weights emerge as its unique Bellman equalizer -- the mixed action that makes the per-round loss independent of which direction nature moves -- with log-partition functions playing the role of value functions. The regret decomposes exactly into three parts: a per-round information loss reflecting the variation in observed outcomes, an additive retempering drift that accounts exactly for any change of measurement scale between rounds, and the information the comparator carries relative to the prior. The variance and bounded-range proxies that drive standard regret bounds are looser relaxations of this decomposition, which holds generally and governs them all. Both players' strategies are read off from the decomposition term by term, and repeated play yields an information-theoretic ledger of self-play in place of the usual quadratic-variation surrogate. The same comparator-class geometry accounts for the classical large-deviation bounds, and methods across bandits, posterior sampling, aggregation, and boosting are specializations of the one regret decomposition.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么贝叶斯更新与在线学习中的指数权重遗憾本质上是同一现象？本文指出，现有研究将两者割裂处理，导致对信息积累、学习速率和集中现象的理解分散。作者旨在统一这些视角，揭示其共享的深层结构：一个由信息预算驱动的重复博弈。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者构建了一个两人零和重复博弈：学习者选择混合策略，自然（对手）在满足相对熵预算的中心化移动中响应。每轮状态由得分累积，终端支付是相对熵球内最优比较器的收益。学习者的策略不受限，而自然的移动受单步重标中心累积量生成函数（RCGF）约束。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明了遗憾可精确分解为三项：内在时间损失、重调温漂移和终端相对熵传输。该恒等式统一了贝叶斯更新、指数权重、大偏差原理等，并表明标准遗憾界只是其松弛。吉布斯权重是唯一使每轮损失独立于自然方向的均衡策略。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过贝尔曼等值器分析，将博弈值与对数划分函数关联。关键在于识别出学习者采用吉布斯分布时，每步势能变化恰好等于RCGF。这使得向前递推替代向后归纳，从而导出路径级精确分解，并通过变尺度调度分析其动态行为。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型局限于熵几何下的最小最大框架，未涵盖非熵正则化情形。尽管无新算法，但其统一视角极具启发性。最值得细读的是核心恒等式的推导及其在汤普森采样、自适应学习、置信序列等场景的特例映射，这对理解学习与推断的本质联系至关重要。

papers.title: Planning Against Learning in Rank-1 Games
papers.titleZh: 在秩-1博弈中对抗学习的规划
papers.abstract: Learning algorithms are often used to make decisions in repeated multi-agent environments. When another player understands how a learner adapts from past experience, that player can plan strategically across rounds to influence the learner's future behavior. Recent work shows that optimizing against Replicator Dynamics, the continuous-time analogue of Multiplicative Weights Update, is tractable in zero-sum games but can be hard in unrestricted general-sum games. We study the first structured class beyond zero sum: bimatrix games satisfying $\text{rank}(A+B)=1$, for which Nash equilibria can be computed in polynomial time. Our main result shows that this equilibrium tractability does not extend to planning against learning dynamics. Unless $\mathsf{P}=\mathsf{NP}$, approximating the optimizer's optimal continuous-time reward within a fixed additive constant is NP-hard even when $\text{rank}(A+B)=1$, the learner starts from the uniform state, and the optimizer is restricted to constant strategies. The hardness persists for bounded payoff matrices and polynomially bounded horizons. We complement this result with structural characterizations of several tractable special cases. Thus rank-one games already separate efficient equilibrium computation from strategic planning against a learning opponent.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当一个理性参与者（优化者）面对一个遵循已知学习规则的对手（学习者）时，能否通过牺牲短期收益来引导对方未来行为？这在拍卖、合同设计等场景中很常见。已有研究发现，在零和博弈中该问题可高效求解，但在一般和博弈中极难。本文聚焦于介于两者之间的秩-1博弈——这类博弈的纳什均衡可在多项式时间内计算，从而检验均衡可解性是否意味着战略规划也可行。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑两个玩家重复博弈：优化者知道学习者的支付矩阵及其采用的复制子动态（Replicator Dynamics），并选择时间依赖的混合策略以最大化累积收益；学习者则根据历史收益连续更新策略。核心设定是双矩阵博弈满足 rank(A+B)=1，即总支付矩阵秩为1。优化者的挑战在于决定是否及如何随时间调整策略，以利用学习者的动态响应。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 主要结论是：即使在秩-1博弈中，逼近优化者的最优连续时间收益也是NP难的，即便限制其使用恒定策略亦然。这表明高效的均衡计算并不自动带来对抗学习者的可规划性。正面结果包括：两动作学习者存在全局排序结构，某些保守情形下恒定策略仍最优，且2×2博弈最多只需一次策略切换即可达最优，揭示了动态优势的存在。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 证明核心是将CLIQUE问题归约到战略规划问题。通过为图中每条边构造四动作‘双曲边构件’，使学习者的状态演化能平滑逼近Motzkin-Straus二次规划，从而将团数估计嵌入优化收益。关键技术是分解秩-1下的累积收益为终点项与路径积分项，并控制近似误差以保持常数间隙，最终导出复杂度下界。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果依赖于学习者动作数无界的构造，固定小动作数（如m=3）是否仍难尚不明确。此外，归约基于特定因子结构，可能高估一般难度。尽管如此，论文价值在于首次揭示秩-1博弈中均衡易解性与战略规划难性的分离，其模型抽象、路径积分分析与开放问题对理解学习系统的战略性操纵至关重要。

papers.title: Does the grand coalition form? Persistence, arrival, and the role of the sharing rule in a dynamic process of nested binding agreements
papers.titleZh: 大联盟会形成吗？嵌套绑定协议动态过程中持久性、到达性与分配规则的作用
papers.abstract: We study a dynamic coalition-formation process in the tradition of Konishi and Ray (2003): players repeatedly form and dissolve binding agreements, evaluate states by discounted long-term expected payoffs, and hold self-confirming beliefs about the process. States and payoff sharing follow Heitzig and Kornek (2018): a state is a hierarchy of nested agreements; agreements are formed by merging existing top-level coalitions, and are terminated together with all agreements containing them; and the members of a new agreement share the surplus it generates, measured against the state without that agreement. All payoff assumptions are structural. We prove that every grand state ever reached is absorbing, and that every absorbing state is grand, for every discount factor. A grand state is actually reached, almost surely, in three cases: small discount factors; three players; and, for any number of players and all discount factors, whenever every player prefers every grand state to every non-grand state in static payoffs, as when distributional stakes are smaller than each player's share of the efficiency gain. Otherwise the process can fail only by cycling for ever among non-grand states. We give exact necessary conditions on such a cycle, and show that for a fixed candidate cycle they reduce to a finite system of linear inequalities in the static payoffs, so the question is decidable. Solving it yields a counterexample: with four players and discount factor one half, under either termination rule, there is an equilibrium that cycles for ever, so the grand coalition need not form. The example survives a far-sighted variant of the sharing rule under which merging raises every player's discounted long-term payoff, not only the static one; there the merge is blocked purely by a better move available to a subgroup. Whether arrival can fail as the discount factor tends to one remains open.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么完全合作最终能否实现仍是未知数？传统静态模型只能判断结构稳定性，却无法回答大联盟是否会形成或持续存在。本文聚焦动态联盟形成过程中的两个核心问题：一旦达成全面合作，它是否持久（持久性）？以及这种状态是否必然会被达到（到达性）？研究特别关注分配规则如何影响这两个问题的答案。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型设定下，玩家反复通过合并或终止来改变当前的嵌套协议层级结构，并基于折现长期期望收益做决策。状态转移遵循链式终止规则：任一协议的解体将导致所有包含它的更高层协议同时失效。收益分配采用固定比例分割新增剩余的方式，该设定独立于底层成本效益模型，仅依赖结构性假设。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明所有已达成的大联盟状态都是吸收态，反之亦然，这适用于任意折现因子。在小折现因子、三玩家情形或当每个玩家偏好任何大联盟胜过非大联盟时，大联盟几乎必然形成。然而，四玩家情况下存在一个反例：即使在远见分享规则下，仍可能出现永远循环而不进入大联盟的均衡。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过构建自洽信念下的马尔可夫过程并分析闭通信类的行为来推导结果。关键技术包括利用‘影子引理’处理终止动作的影响路径，结合线性不等式系统验证循环存在的必要条件，并借助混合整数线性规划求解反例。对远见分享规则的分析则揭示了长期收益分配如何改变激励结构。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设效用可无限制转移，现实中可能受限。此外，关于高折现因子下到达性的开放问题仍未解决，尤其在单边退出与短视分配规则组合时。最值得阅读的是其清晰的动态框架、对持久性与到达性的分离分析，以及揭示分配规则作为关键杠杆的深刻洞见。

papers.title: Self-Bounding Regret Matching+ in Potential Games and Product-Simplex Optimization
papers.titleZh: 潜在博弈与乘积单形优化中的自约束遗憾匹配+
papers.abstract: Regret matching+ (RM+) is parameter free, scale invariant, and central to large game solving, but its only general individual-regret guarantee grows as $\sqrt{T}$. A recent ICLR result used this envelope to prove that RM+ reaches an $ε$-stationary point of a smooth objective over a product of simplices in $O(ε^{-4})$ iterations, or $O(ε^{-8})$ from the standard zero initialization. We give an exact one-step conservation law for RM+. It states that forward utility gain pays for both squared state motion and growth of the regret-state norm. Norm growth is at most $\sqrt{m-1}$ times forward gain for $m$ actions, and the coefficient is sharp. This yields four results for unmodified RM+. Its regret on any utility path is controlled by centered temporal variation. Its regret is uniformly bounded under alternating play in every finite exact potential game, resolving an open question and making squared activation gaps summable. Both certified lazy and ordinary cyclic play attain an $ε^{-2}$ exponent. On any smooth, possibly nonconcave simplex objective, RM+ finds an $ε$-KKT point in $O(ε^{-2})$ iterations. Most broadly, for a smooth objective over an arbitrary product of simplices, cyclic block RM+ attains the same $O(ε^{-2})$ exponent from arbitrary initialization, with an explicit trajectory-dependent constant. The proof controls the finite objective loss caused by low-state blocks and then self-bounds every block state and the total squared path length. Complete proofs cover zero states, sharpness, common-profile stationarity, and robust gain dominance. Oracle-normalized diagnostics compare RM+ with predictive and smooth extra-gradient variants on graphical potential games and dense nonconvex objectives.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么标准遗憾匹配+（RM+）在潜在博弈中表现优异却缺乏理论解释？过去虽知RM+广泛用于大规模博弈求解，但其个体遗憾仅被证明为√T量级，在潜在博弈中是否恒定仍是开放问题。本文针对这一理论缺口，探究RM+在结构化游戏与优化问题中的内在稳定性机制。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者考虑玩家在有限动作空间上通过RM+进行自适应学习的动态过程，其中策略由非负遗憾向量归一化得到。在精确潜在博弈中，个体效用变化对应于全局势能增量；在光滑优化问题中，梯度驱动更新。模型涵盖单个及乘积单形上的序列与循环更新规则，关注无参数、尺度不变的原始RM+流程。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明了RM+满足一个精确的一步守恒律：前向收益同时支付状态移动和遗憾范数增长。由此推出，在任意潜在博弈中RM+的遗憾被势能范围统一上界控制，首次证实其恒定遗憾特性，并导出激活间隙可求和等更强结论。对于光滑非凸优化，RM+可在O(ε⁻²)步内找到ε-KKT点，显著优于此前O(ε⁻⁴)结果。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心在于发现并利用RM+更新的精确恒等式，结合锐化的前向增益电荷不等式（Rₜ − Rₜ₋₁ ≤ √(m−1)Dₜ），建立遗憾与路径变化之间的自约束关系。通过分析正向线性增益与目标改进的关系，并对低状态块引入运动预算控制，实现了跨区块的联合边界封闭，从而处理乘积结构下的交互影响。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果依赖循环更新假设，无法直接推广至同步更新；常数项受最小初态范数δ影响，可能较小。尽管如此，该文揭示了RM+内在的自我调节机制，其守恒律视角新颖深刻。最值得阅读的是其主恒等式、尖锐性构造及对低状态损失的预算控制技巧，为理解无参数学习动态提供了新工具。

papers.title: Fairness--Stability Trade-offs in Many-to-One Matching
papers.titleZh: 多对一匹配中的公平性-稳定性权衡
papers.abstract: We study the trade-off between firm-side fairness and coalition stability in many-to-one matching markets with transferable payments. For a fixed matching $X$, we characterize the largest supportable core factor by a bottleneck financing problem: $α(X)=1/Φ(X)$, where $Φ(X)=\min_{z\ge0}\max_i R_i(X,z)$. This yields a polynomial-time linear program and local sensitivity formulas for one-worker reallocations. We then develop a maximum-edge round algorithm and a broader class of mutual-top safe choices. Every safe execution is EF1 and, with $t=δ(A)$ denoting the minimum positive-edge quality, guarantees $α(X)\ge\max\{t,1/[m-(m-1)t]\}$ and $SW(X)/OPT\geq t+(1-t)/m$. These bounds give finite-firm lower and upper bounds for the EF1--core minimax frontier, with exact results for two firms and for three firms when $δ\le1/2$; as the number of firms grows, the tight scale-free stability rate is $δ$. We also extend the financing formulation to stronger $EFX^+$ fairness and capacity-constrained markets.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当一个中央平台在分配人才、项目或岗位时，既要考虑效率，也要兼顾公平与稳定性。然而，传统稳定匹配（如Gale-Shapley）要求工人被分配到对其价值最高的企业，这可能导致强者恒强。本文研究的问题是：当决策者强制实施一种更公平的分配（如企业间工人价值包更平衡），会损失多少稳定性？这种权衡是否存在紧的下界？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型设定在一个多对一匹配市场中，企业对工人有加法估值，允许转移支付（如工资）。匹配的稳定性由α-核心衡量，公平性则采用企业侧的EF1标准——每个企业认为自己的工人包至少不差于移除某他人一个工人后的包。研究关注在满足EF1的前提下，最大可支持的α值。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文的核心结果是建立了EF1与近似核心之间的最小最大前沿（minimax frontier）。对于m个企业的市场，定义正边质量δ为最低相对价值，证明了任何EF1匹配所能支持的最大核心因子α(X)满足Im(δ) ≤ Hm(δ) ≤ um(δ)，并在两企业情形完全刻画，在三企业且δ≤1/2时达到紧界。当企业数趋于无穷，紧的尺度无关稳定率为δ。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 关键技术是‘融资-稳定性恒等式’：a(X)=1/ρ(X)，其中ρ(X)是最小化后的最大企业稳定压力比。该比值将稳定性转化为关于工资的极小极大优化问题，并可用线性规划精确求解。通过分析单个工人调整对各企业压力比的影响，结合最大边轮次算法与互顶安全选择，实现了全局稳定性控制。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型依赖加法估值与转移支付，难以直接推广至互补性或非转移情境。结果虽具紧界，但主要针对最坏情况。值得阅读之处在于其清晰的分解思想：将人员分配与薪酬设计分离，用ρ作为二次优化指标。其方法论对理解公平与稳定的内在冲突提供了可计算的分析框架。

papers.title: CompCPZ: Preserving Multi-Modal Intent in Language-Guided Robot Manipulation
papers.titleZh: CompCPZ: 在语言引导的机器人操作中保持多模态意图
papers.abstract: A robot asked to "place the cup near the red plate or the blue plate" may reach the centroid between them and appear geometrically successful, while satisfying neither disjunct of the instruction. This silent semantic failure exposes a structural limitation of language-conditioned robot policies: representations that collapse a disjunctive instruction into a single connected set cannot preserve all feasible modes, and planners that commit to one action degrade under run-time mode uncertainty. We address this limitation with CompCPZ, a sound algebraic layer that language-conditioned learning systems wrap to recover multi-modal disjunctive representation, recursively composing per-primitive constrained polynomial zonotope enclosures along the language parse tree with distribution-free conformal coverage and sub-millisecond runtime. On a closed-loop ManiSkill3 tabletop-manipulation benchmark, CompCPZ outperforms convex set baselines, multi-peak decoders, and a zero-shot vision-language-action model (1,900/1,918 paired wins, p << 10^(-30)); the same compiler also transfers without retuning to planar real-robot trials on a Unitree Go2 quadruped under motion capture. These results suggest that compositional language grounding should be evaluated not only by reaching a decoded target, but by whether the represented feasibility set preserves the connected-component structure of the user's intent.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有语言引导的机器人系统在处理‘靠近红盘或蓝盘’这类析取指令时，常将目标坍缩为单一几何中心区域，导致虽几何上成功却违背用户真实意图的‘沉默语义失败’。根本问题在于传统方法无法在表示层面保留多模态意图的连通分量结构，任何单点动作规划或单连通集编码在运行时模式不确定性下必然失效。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文在ManiSkill3模拟操作基准和Unitree Go2四足机器人实机上测试闭环保任务。输入为自然语言指令与视觉观测，输出为末端执行器的目标区域。系统通过解析指令为语法树，逐层组合约束多项式zonotope（CPZ）来构建可行集，并以是否进入真实可行模式作为核心评估指标，而非仅看几何接近度。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文揭示了多模态语言接地的结构性下界：任何连通分量数少于语义模式数的声望建模，其Hausdorff误差至少为模式间距的一半。CompCPZ首次实现了从语言解析树到声克组件集的可证明组合编译，在18项任务中以1900/1918的配对胜率显著超越凸包基线、多峰解码器和零样本视觉-语言-动作模型。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: CompCPZ将语言指令解析为由合取、析取、否定构成的语法树，每个叶节点通过视觉检测与保形校准生成双侧CPZ包围盒。内部节点则递归应用CPZ的交、并、补运算，从而在集合代数层面忠实还原布尔结构。该方法保障了分布无关的覆盖率传播与亚毫秒级运行时间，支持运行时模式切换。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法当前限于轴对齐语法下的深度无关稳定性，且未扩展至长视野或时序逻辑。实机验证基于平面运动，尚未涉及接触丰富的灵巧操作。最值得阅读的是其将语言接地重构为声克集合表示问题的视角、理论下界的证明，以及跨仿真与实体平台的严谨实验设计，对评测语言-动作系统具有深远启示。

papers.title: Prism-GRPO: Faster VLA Policy Optimization via Splitting Same-outcome Groups
papers.titleZh: Prism-GRPO：通过拆分相同结果组加速视觉-语言-动作策略优化
papers.abstract: GRPO is increasingly used for reinforcement learning of vision-language-action (VLA) policies because, unlike PPO, it does not require training a critic. This simplification comes with a sampling cost: group-relative advantages require multiple rollouts from each scene. Under binary success rewards, groups whose rollouts all succeed or all fail have zero advantage and are discarded by dynamic sampling. These groups are especially common early in training, when most rollouts fail, wasting much of the expensive robotic rollout budget. We introduce Prism-GRPO, which augments binary outcome reward with a weighted trajectory-level execution-quality score. By splitting same-outcome groups into a quality spectrum, Prism-GRPO recovers training signal while ensuring that every success still outranks every failure. Quality scores can be derived from simulator contacts, executed actions, or visual observations, avoiding task-specific progress rewards. We prove that Prism-GRPO never increases the probability that a sampled group is discarded for having zero advantages, and derive a gradient-alignment condition under which its combined update remains a local ascent direction for task success. Across four RoboTwin tasks spanning different horizons and coordination patterns, Prism-GRPO improves success and quality at matched rollout budgets and reaches target success rates with up to 56% fewer rollouts. It also suppresses a reward-hacking shortcut, with the cleaner behavior transferring under direct deployment to a real robot. Through ablations, we show consistent gains across contact-, smoothness-, and VLM-derived quality signals.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 在机器人控制中，基于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）的强化学习常采用GRPO这类无需批评网络的方法，但其依赖二值成功奖励会导致大量采样浪费——当一组轨迹全部成功或失败时，无法产生优势差异，训练信号丢失。尤其在训练初期，多数轨迹失败，导致动态采样频繁丢弃数据，严重降低样本效率。本文旨在解决这一因奖励稀疏导致的低效问题。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究在RoboTwin仿真环境中进行，任务涵盖抓取、移动、传递和敲击等操作，输入为视觉观测与语言指令，输出为机械臂动作序列。模型基于预训练VLA策略，通过强化学习微调。评估不仅看任务成功率，还引入执行质量指标，如非目标接触力、运动平滑性等，以衡量行为的物理合理性，并在真实机器人上测试部署可靠性。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出Prism-GRPO，在保持二值成功奖励主导的前提下，引入一个有界的轨迹级执行质量得分作为辅助奖励，从而在相同结果的组内建立优势梯度。实验显示，该方法在达到相同成功率时可减少最多56%的 rollout 数量，同时提升执行质量，并抑制了奖励欺骗行为，其更清洁的行为在真实机器人上表现更可靠。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法核心是组合奖励R = success + λq，其中q为执行质量（如最小化非目标接触），λ < 1确保成功始终优于失败。使用留一法（RLOO）优势估计器保留质量项的尺度，使同结果组也能提供有效梯度。理论证明该设计不会增加无效组概率，且在成功与质量梯度对齐时，联合更新仍朝向任务成功方向。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法依赖可观测的执行质量信号，在缺乏接触或动作数据的场景需依赖代理模型（如VLM）估算，可能引入噪声。虽然实验证明多种质量信号均有效，但其与任务成功的梯度对齐假设难以完全验证。最值得读的是其奖励机制设计思路和对样本效率瓶颈的工程化解决方案。

papers.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See
papers.titleZh: 用低资源语言思考：SFT 构建了什么，RL 修复了什么，准确率无法看见什么
papers.abstract: Take three frontier mixture-of-experts models (Alibaba, OpenAI, NVIDIA; 3.6-4.0B active parameters each) and fine-tune them to reason in a low-resource language. On accuracy benchmarks almost nothing happens, and the benchmark itself is noise at this scale: changing only the random seed moves the score by 7.7 points, more than every data and recipe effect we measured. That null is our first result. The real changes live where accuracy cannot see. Base models never think in Greek: 0 of 1,000 reasoning traces, even when the question is Greek, so the model answers correctly while reasoning in a form its user cannot read, audit, or correct. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), every released checkpoint reasons in the language of the question on ~98% of items, one family at 3x fewer tokens, with judged grammaticality improving on all four models and general ability within a few points of each base: nothing was forgotten, and fluency was gained. We propose six behavioural dimensions that make such changes measurable, each gated to reject any metric that correlates with output length, and we report how our own instruments lied: six failures, each caught by a control. What SFT cannot do is fix its own defects: a quarter of answers skip the requested format, answers leak into the reasoning channel, and an explicit "think in English" is obeyed under half the time. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, pre-registered before training, fixes the first two outright (fallback 24% to 2.5%, leak 3.5% to 0.0%, both against a flat random-reward control) and moves the third (+9.1pp), while the Greek reasoning habit survives an accuracy-only gradient untouched. We release five checkpoints. The instruments, the controls and the pre-registration travel to any low-resource language; Greek is the case that let us measure them.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么现有微调评估无法反映低资源语言推理的真实改进？因为主流做法依赖单一准确率指标，而该指标在低资源场景下受训练噪声主导，无法捕捉模型是否真正用目标语言进行推理、资源消耗变化或指令遵循能力等关键行为转变。本文揭示，准确率不变不等于无进展。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究设定为在三种稀疏MoE模型上进行希腊语长链推理微调，输入为希腊语问题及合成的思维链，输出为带显式推理过程的回答。通过多维度自动与人工评测，衡量语言一致性、预算使用、格式遵循等六项指标，并设计种子控制、配对测试等严格实验协议以排除虚假相关。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文核心发现是监督微调（SFT）使模型从英语内部推理切换为希腊语推理，且更适应问题难度分配预算，但这些进步被准确率噪声掩盖。强化学习（RL）可修复SFT引入的格式缺陷，如答案泄露与格式缺失，且不影响已建立的语言习惯，证明行为修复可独立于性能提升。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法的关键在于分离可观测行为与准确率：通过语言比例、中间步骤计数、预算超支率等长度无关指标量化推理行为；用预注册的对照实验（如仅变种子）界定噪声基线；并设计可验证奖励的RL来修正SFT无法自纠的结构性缺陷，其有效性由对抗性控制组验证。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论受限于稀疏MoE架构与LoRA适配器，且未测试更低资源语言。尽管如此，其严谨的评测框架、对训练变异性的量化、仪器失效案例及修复路径，使其成为低资源语言部署的重要参考。最值得读的是其实验设计与失败分析，而非最终模型性能。

papers.title: MANIGUARD: A Benchmark and Data Suite for Specification-Grounded Safety Evaluation and Improvement of Robotic Manipulation
papers.titleZh: MANIGUARD: 一种基于规范的机器人操作安全评估与改进基准及数据套件
papers.abstract: Foundation-model policies for robotic manipulation are advancing rapidly on task success, but rigorous evaluation of whether they succeed safely is still lacking. We introduce ManiGuard, a specification-grounded framework for evaluating and improving the safety of foundation-model manipulation, comprising the ManiGuard-Bench task suite and a paired safety-annotated trajectory-generation pipeline. ManiGuard-Bench organizes six contact-rich household task families into 200 locked base tasks along a skill $\times$ constraint taxonomy, with safety specified independently of task success. Each task is evaluated under one in-distribution and four single-axis out-of-distribution perturbations that hold the safety specification fixed, giving 1,000 locked scenarios. Every rollout is runtime-checked by LTL$_f$-grounded automaton monitors over physics-grounded predicates rather than learned classifiers or LLM judges, in simulation and on a physical Franka platform. The pipeline pairs an automated motion-planning generator with human teleoperation, annotated by the same per-step monitor, and directly supports safety-aware fine-tuning; we release 8,000 safety-annotated demonstrations, 40 per base task. Benchmarking zero-shot and fine-tuned VLAs across more than 23,000 rollouts, we find: (i) safety must be evaluated independently of task success, as 6-21% of successful rollouts violate the specification; (ii) fine-tuning on our suite raises safe task completion from near zero to 7.5-29.8% and engaged-and-safe behavior from 16-40% to 51-72%; but (iii) a gap remains that scaling demonstrations does not close, with 21-42% of engaged rollouts still violating, two of six families below 2% safe success for every policy, and these failures persisting under distribution shift and on hardware.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当前机器人操作的基础模型政策虽在任务成功率上进展迅速，但缺乏对其行为安全性的严谨评估。现有基准大多仅关注任务完成，忽视执行过程中的物理安全，如碰撞、倾倒或违反操作顺序。由于真实世界试错成本高，亟需一个能在仿真中暴露安全风险、且独立于任务成功的评测体系。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文构建了ManiGuard-Bench，包含200个家庭场景下的接触密集型操作任务，覆盖六类技能与约束组合。每个任务定义了独立于目标完成的形式化安全规范（LTLf），通过自动机监控器在仿真中逐帧检查。评估涵盖分布内与四种单因素扰动场景，并同步在实体机械臂上测试。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了首个将安全规范、轨迹级监控、扰动鲁棒性与实体验证结合的机器人操作安全评测框架。实验发现任务成功不等于安全，6-21%的成功轨迹仍违反安全规范。微调可提升安全表现，但仍有21-42%的活跃轨迹违规，且部分任务家族始终难以突破2%安全成功率。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心是使用LTLf公式表达安全约束，并编译为确定性有限自动机进行运行时监控，避免依赖易变的LLM或分类器判断。安全标注的数据集通过自动化运动规划与遥操作共同生成，确保演示本身满足规范。同一监控器用于评估与数据标注，使训练与评测标准一致。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 局限在于仅覆盖六类任务与特定物理模拟，安全断言依赖预设谓词与仿真保真度，且未验证更复杂的安全恢复机制。最值得读的是其问题设定与系统设计，它揭示了安全不能靠更多同质数据解决，推动了规范驱动的评测与数据收集新方向。

papers.title: Reconfiguration-Complete Motion Primitives with Constructive Planning for Deformable Planar Modular Robots
papers.titleZh: 用于可变形平面模块化机器人的重构完备运动基元与构造性规划
papers.abstract: The continuously deformable geometry of modular robots makes it difficult to define a fixed representation for reconfiguration planning and analysis. This letter introduces a square-cell abstraction that maps deformable rhombus modules to fixed-size grid cells while retaining physically interpretable local motions through two primitives, pivoting and shearing. Under this abstraction, we prove that every non-straight edge-connected configuration with $N \geq 7$ can be transformed to a fixed canonical staircase using only admissible primitive motions. Since these motions are reversible, any two configurations in this class are mutually reconfigurable. The proof is constructive and directly yields a staircase-canonicalization planner that transports removable boundary modules while preserving connectivity. As a practical enhancement, we further introduce a boundary-to-delivery lookahead selector that ranks admissible high level choices without affecting the completeness guarantee. Experiments demonstrate the constructive reconfiguration process and show that the selector substantially reduces planning time, while reference comparisons indicate lower planning times than the prior framework over the shared module counts.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 模块化自重构机器人因几何连续变形导致状态表示困难，现有方法难以兼顾物理可执行性和全局可达性分析。传统规划依赖启发式或辅助结构，缺乏完备性保证。本文聚焦于可变形菱形模块，试图解决如何在固定离散表示下保留局部运动可行性的同时，实现任意构型间的相互转换。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究基于方形网格抽象，将每个菱形模块映射为占据单位格的单元，定义两种可逆基本运动：绕顶点旋转的‘转动’和基于2×2模块块的‘剪切’。任务是判断两个相同规模的非直线连通构型之间是否存在由这些基元构成的重构序列，并构造具体路径。评价标准为能否完成向规范阶梯形的归约及总规划时间。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明了所有模块数N≥7的非直线边连通构型均可通过允许的基元动作变换为统一的规范阶梯形，从而建立了互重构性。由此导出的构造性规划器能逐步收割边界模块并运输至阶梯末端。实验显示该方法在随机实例上成功率100%，且引入前瞻选择器后显著降低规划耗时。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法核心是构造性归约过程：维护一个阶梯前缀、剩余模块集和一个可移动的五或六模块载具。通过引理确保始终存在可移除的边界模块，利用转动与剪切组合使载具沿边界移动，并在拾取后标准化其形态。整个流程保持连通性，最终将载具合并入阶梯。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论依赖于理想化的网格抽象与无碰撞外部空间假设，尚未在闭环硬件中验证。归约路径未必最优，且仅适用于N≥7的大规模构型。最值得阅读的是其构造性证明思路与从理论引理到规划器的直接转化方式，展示了如何将可达性证明转化为实用算法的设计范式。
